affected_objects.content: The baseline approach of using the entire transcript as context for a model is infeasible due to the context length limitations of current models, thus justifying the need for a more complex memory architecture like the proposed three-layer system.
The team needs to revisit and redefine the memory architecture, building upon the existing framework, to better structure long-term meeting memory.

It is speculated that "Li Linsen's work" is not a sophisticated memory system but rather a simple Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach over scraped personal experiences, combined with a stylistic prompt for fact retrieval.
The system design will assume that raw recording data is stored long-term.
An unresolved question is whether implementing short-term memory as a cache is functionally equivalent and architecturally 'cleaner' than creating a separate, dedicated working memory.
Resolve the design debate on whether to implement short-term memory as a dedicated, 'cleaner' component or as a cache for frequently accessed information within a single unified memory system.
